description: This file defines an abstract class Clock with a method now(), and a concrete implementation SystemClock that returns the current UTC date and time.

classes.name: Clock
classes.description: An abstract class that requires implementing a now() method returning the current DateTime.

classes.name: SystemClock
classes.description: A concrete implementation of Clock that returns the current system date and time in UTC.

methods.name: now
methods.description: Abstract method to get the current DateTime.

methods.name: now
methods.description: Overrides the abstract method; returns current UTC DateTime.
